verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a documented public API reference at docs.synthesia.io. It covers a Video API for generating avatar videos, dubbing, translation and templates; an Upload API; a Billing API; and an Interactive Avatars API. The quickstart documents polling, webhooks and mp4 download links, and an llms.txt file on the docs site confirms the API documentation is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API use.
